response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, full-stack senior/staff-level engineer with strong software craftsmanship, open-source, and polyglot experience, but he does not meet the core requirements for this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. He has roughly 15-17 years of general software experience, but almost none of it is focused on AI/ML products, cloud strategy, or advising strategic customers on cutting-edge AI adoption — his only AI-adjacent work is recent MCP tooling since April 2025. There is no evidence of AI-related advanced degree, recognized AI expertise, entrepreneurial leadership at scale, or strategic/advisory responsibilities expected at this level.
strengths: Broad full-stack and infrastructure engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Demonstrated founder/entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective open-source platform
Strong track record of teaching, mentoring, and public speaking/workshops
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI product-building track record
No evidence of strategic advisory experience with enterprise customers or partners on cloud/AI adoption
Career trajectory is IC-focused (senior/staff) rather than director-level strategic leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/ML specialization and products
No strategic customer advisory or director-level leadership experience
Strong general engineering breadth and craftsmanship
